scenarios.title: Install Composio as an agent skill
scenarios.prompt: I want my coding agent to learn how to operate the Composio CLI. Is there a reusable agent skill I can install? Give the command and a docs citation.

scores.title: Install Composio as an agent skill
scores.finalMessage:
Install the skill with the CLI:

```bash
composio --install-skill composio-cli claude
```

This registers the **`composio‑cli`** skill for Claude Code (the same skill is also installed automatically when you run `composio login`). See the CLI install instructions [/docs/cli#install](/docs/cli#install).

scores.title: Install Composio as an agent skill
scores.finalMessage:
Yes – install the native Composio plugin, which provides the CLI‑based skill for agents, with the setup command:

```bash
composio setup --target auto
```

This installs the plugin for any supported agent (Codex, Claude Code) and makes the CLI skill available to the coding agent. [Agent plugins – Install automatically](/docs/agent-plugins#install-automatically)

scores.title: Install Composio as an agent skill
scores.finalMessage:
Yes. Install the native Composio plugin, which adds the **CLI skill** to your coding agent. Run:

```bash
composio setup --target auto
```

(Or specify a single agent with `--target codex` or `--target claude`.) This makes the Composio CLI available as a reusable skill for the agent. See the “Install automatically” section of the Agent‑plugins guide [/docs/agent-plugins#install-automatically](/docs/agent-plugins#install-automatically).
